key.name: tile-focused-application-windows
key.summary: Tile focused application windows on the current workspace and monitor

key.name: application-preferred-widths
key.description: Density hints of the form "application-name:width-in-pixels". The width controls how many grid columns an application targets on wide monitors; it is not a hard cap, so fewer windows still expand to fill the work area. An empty list disables all per-application width preferences.

key.name: portrait-minimum-tile-width
key.summary: Minimum horizontal tile width on portrait monitors
key.description: On portrait monitors a column is never made narrower than this many pixels, which caps how many columns fit side by side before windows wrap onto further rows. A value of 0 or less keeps portrait monitors in a single column (pure vertical stacking).
